purpose: Create an open club with valid required data and assignments.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated.
The coordinator and co-coordinator are valid students.
The Club Faculty Councillor is valid faculty.
The category is Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
action_or_input: Student Admin creates a club with the required data and valid assignments.
expected_result: Club creation succeeds and the club is open.

purpose: Confirm an open club under Student Admin control.
preconditions: An open club exists.
Student Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student Admin approves the club.
expected_result: The club becomes confirmed.

purpose: Reject club creation when a coordinator assignment is not a valid student.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated.
A coordinator or co-coordinator assignment refers to a person who is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits the club creation request.
expected_result: The invalid assignment is not accepted and the club is not created.

purpose: Reject club creation when the Club Faculty Councillor is not valid faculty.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated.
The proposed Club Faculty Councillor is not a valid faculty member.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits the club creation request.
expected_result: The invalid assignment is not accepted and the club is not created.

purpose: Reject a club category outside the allowed set.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated.
Required club data and valid student and faculty assignments are supplied.
The proposed category is not Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits the club creation request.
expected_result: The category is not accepted and the club is not created.

purpose: Apply for membership in a confirmed club.
preconditions: A confirmed club exists.
The student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: The student applies to the club.
expected_result: The application is created in the open state.

purpose: Prevent applications to clubs that are not confirmed.
preconditions: An open, unconfirmed club exists.
The student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: The student applies to the club.
expected_result: The application is not created.

purpose: Prevent a duplicate application to the same club.
preconditions: A confirmed club exists.
The student already has an application to that club.
action_or_input: The student applies to the same club again.
expected_result: No duplicate application is created.

purpose: Allow applications to different clubs.
preconditions: Two confirmed clubs exist.
The student has an application to the first club and none to the second.
action_or_input: The student applies to the second club.
expected_result: An application to the second club is created.

purpose: Approve an open membership application as the applicable Club Head.
preconditions: A membership application is open.
The actor is the applicable Club Head for the club.
action_or_input: The Club Head approves the application.
expected_result: The membership becomes confirmed.

purpose: Prevent approval by someone who is not the applicable Club Head.
preconditions: A membership application is open.
The actor is not the applicable Club Head for the club.
action_or_input: The actor attempts to approve the application.
expected_result: The application is not approved and remains open.

purpose: Create a poll with at least two choices and selected target groups.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
Valid target groups are available.
action_or_input: The Club Head creates a poll with at least two choices and selects target groups.
expected_result: The poll is created open with its target audience defined, and the intended audience is notified.

purpose: Prevent creation of a poll with fewer than two choices.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
Valid target groups are available.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a poll with fewer than two choices.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

purpose: Record one vote from an eligible targeted student in an active poll.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired.
The student belongs to the poll's target audience.
The student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: The student submits a vote.
expected_result: The vote is recorded for the student in the poll.

purpose: Prevent voting in a poll that is inactive or expired.
preconditions: The poll is inactive or expired.
The student belongs to its target audience.
The student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: The student attempts to vote.
expected_result: The vote is not recorded.

purpose: Prevent a student outside the poll's target audience from voting.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired.
The student does not belong to its target audience.
The student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: The student attempts to vote.
expected_result: The vote is not recorded.

purpose: Prevent a second vote by the same student in the same poll.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired.
The student belongs to its target audience.
The student has already voted in the poll.
action_or_input: The student attempts to vote again.
expected_result: No second vote is recorded.

purpose: Book a session at a configured venue with a valid time range.
preconditions: A configured venue is available.
The proposed venue and date have no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: The Club Head books a session with a start time earlier than its end time.
expected_result: The session booking succeeds and a notification is sent.

purpose: Reject a session booking whose start time does not precede its end time.
preconditions: A configured venue is available.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a session booking with a start time equal to or later than its end time.
expected_result: The booking is not accepted.

purpose: Book an event at a configured venue with a valid time range.
preconditions: A configured venue is available.
The proposed venue and date have no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: The Club Head books an event with a start time earlier than its end time.
expected_result: The event booking succeeds and a notification is sent.

purpose: Prevent overlapping sessions and events in the same venue on the same date, including cross-type conflicts.
preconditions: A session or event is already booked at a venue on a date.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a session or event at the same venue and date with an overlapping time window.
expected_result: The overlapping booking is not accepted.

purpose: Maintain valid coordinator and co-coordinator assignments when club leadership changes.
preconditions: A club exists.
The proposed coordinator and co-coordinator are valid students.
action_or_input: The Club Head changes the club leadership assignments.
expected_result: The valid leadership assignments are maintained for the club.

purpose: Submit and retain a non-negative club budget request with supporting documentation.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
A supporting file is available.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a budget request with a non-negative amount and the supporting file.
expected_result: The request and supporting documentation are retained for tracking.

purpose: Reject a club budget request with a negative amount.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
A supporting file is available.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a budget request with a negative amount.
expected_result: The request is not accepted.

purpose: Require supporting documentation for a club budget request.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
No supporting file is supplied.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits a budget request with a non-negative amount.
expected_result: The request is not accepted.

source_id: Problem Statement 4.1 / Submit Club Event Report
purpose: Submit and retain a club event report with its required report/details file.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
A report/details file is available.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits an event report with the file.
expected_result: The report and file are centrally stored and accessible for review by the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.

purpose: Require a report/details file for a club event report.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
No report/details file is supplied.
action_or_input: The Club Head submits an event report without the file.
expected_result: The report is not accepted.
